correctness.rationale: The Sato--Tate centered-window construction is valid uniformly in the interior; dyadic conditioning costs O(M) because sum 2^j (J-j+1) is O(2^J); conditional centered sums have expected supremum O(sqrt(log M/M)); tail and Fejér errors have the same smaller scale, proving the stated bound under all quantified hypotheses.
